findings.body:
Adding `'24'` only multiplies identical jobs: nothing in this workflow reads `matrix.node`, so neither Node 20 nor Node 24 is installed or selected. Both matrix legs run `npm test` on whatever Node the runner image ships, which misses the PR goal of covering the Node 24 LTS line and wastes a duplicate CI leg.

Wire the version into the job before merging, for example `actions/setup-node` with `node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}` (and usually `actions/checkout` plus an explicit `runs-on`).

summary:
## Verdict

The matrix edit does not achieve "test on Node 24": `matrix.node` is never referenced, so GitHub Actions will schedule two identical jobs on the runner default instead of installing Node 20 and 24.

## Notes

`.github/workflows/test.yml` only gained `'24'` in the strategy matrix. The job still has a single step (`run: npm test`) with no `actions/setup-node` (or equivalent) using `${{ matrix.node }}`, no `actions/checkout`, and no `runs-on`. Expanding the matrix therefore doubles wall-time and billable minutes without changing the Node binary under test.

Pre-existing gaps worth fixing in a follow-up (not introduced on a diff line here): missing job-level `permissions:`, missing `runs-on`, and missing checkout before `npm test`.

**Recommendation:** request-changes
